name: H05_hare_apparent_counts_only_your_own_other_hares
note: Hare Apparent: 'other creatures you control named Hare Apparent'. The opponent controls a Hare Apparent and P0 controls only other creatures with other names; P0 casts its first Hare Apparent: nothing is counted (neither the opponent's Hare, nor P0's Bear, nor the entering Hare), so no Rabbit is created.
